versions.subject: Merge PR #5717 from @tropChaud - Add and Enhance Windows Default Domain GPO & RDP Tampering Rules
versions.detection:
# "C:\Windows\System32\gpme.msc" /s /gpobject:"LDAP://<REDACTED>/cn<REDACTED>,cnpolicies,cnsystem,DC<REDACTED>,DClocal"
selection_mmc:
    - Image|endswith: '\mmc.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'MMC.exe'
selection_gpme:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'gpme.msc'
        - 'gpobject:'
selection_default_gpos:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '31B2F340-016D-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9' # Default Domain Policy GUID
        - '6AC1786C-016F-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9' # Default Domain Controllers Policy GUID
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\mmc.exe" OR OriginalFileName="MMC.exe" CommandLine="*gpme.msc*" CommandLine="*gpobject:*" CommandLine IN ("*31B2F340-016D-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9*", "*6AC1786C-016F-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9*")
